messages:
alex: Heads-up — I’m seeing a small perf regression in kernel selection for very short contexts on Hopper after the latest autotune push.

maria: which path? prefill or decode?

alex: It’s happening at the initial path pick. For seq_len <= 48 the tuner now prefers the fused-kernel tuned for 64+, which bumps p50 by ~10% and p99 by ~12% on a subset of runs.

sam: can you paste the profiler output?

alex: sure — quick snippet from pprof for a batch of short requests:

```
pprof: local
-> fused_kernel_run: 48%
-> decode_safe_kernel: 30%
-> kv_cache_lookup: 12%
-> copying/packing: 10%

latency_summary:
  p50: 12.3ms (expected ~11.0ms)
  p95: 45ms
  p99: 120ms
```

chloe: that pattern smells like our routing decision is only looking at historical median slen. When traffic is bimodal (lots of 16/32 and bursts of 128+), the median bias causes misroutes.

maria: i also noticed increased KV cache miss spikes around the same time — probably thrash from mixed sessions.

sam: could be two problems: (1) kernel pick criterion needs per-arch + per-slen quantiles, (2) KV miss-induced prefill re-population hurts short-ctx latency.

chloe: suggestion: hybrid routing policy — check (a) short-term slen histogram, (b) recent kv-miss-rate, and (c) kernel microbench delta. Use a cheap fast-path check to prefer decode-safe kernel when miss-rate > threshold.

alex: prototype plan: keep per-arch per-slen running quantiles (5/50/95) in memory, compute a 10s sliding window kv-miss-rate, and add a tie-breaker that penalizes fused-kernel when miss-rate is high for that pod.

maria: and add a small hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping. maybe a 30s cooldown after switching paths?

sam: also add a tiny prefill micro-backoff: if a session triggers >X consecutive misses, delay prefill by 5-10ms and fall back to decode path for that request. Should lower thrash.

alex: implementing flags: `slen.hybrid_routing=true`, `slen.hybrid_kv_miss_threshold=0.15`, `slen.switch_cooldown_s=30`, `slen.prefill_backoff_ms=7`. Will canary on Ampere and Hopper subsets.

chloe: +perf harness change: simulate bimodal slen (p=0.7 short(16), p=0.3 long(128)) and inject kv miss bursts to validate improvements. Add to regression suite.

maria: good. metrics to track: p50/p95/p99, kv-miss-rate, kernel-select-distribution, and redispatch/drop-rate.

alex: will push a canary rollout today. small checklist: instrument per-pod counters, wire them to the console chart, enable `slen.hybrid_routing` on eng-runtime-canary only.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled to eng-runtime-canary group at 22:00 UTC :rocket:

sam: once data is in, we should compare tail-latency delta and how often we switch kernels. if switch-rate > 0.05 per request, tighten cooldown.

chloe: and add alerting if kv-miss-rate spikes > 0.3 for >60s during canary.

alex: agreed. will post results in this thread. thanks all.

maria: :thumbsup:
